purpose: Teach: 連合/入手/出場/総務/プレス/出荷/故障/名義

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、業界、絶対、連合、絶対、立ち上げに、絶対、関わったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, your father was absolutely there, truly involved in building that industry alliance. I'm telling you, I owe him everything.
lines.style: Measured, nostalgic opening. Each memory arrives like a small stone placed carefully. Voice carries weight of decades. Quiet pride underneath the gravity. Slight pause between images — he's seeing it again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、新規顧客の、絶対、入手、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we've continued his work acquiring new clients with that same seriousness and care. I'm grateful for everything he built.
lines.style: Formal respect with genuine warmth beneath. Steady, unhurried pace. Each phrase lands with deliberate weight. He's not reciting — he's confirming a truth they both know. Eyes level, posture straight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、業界大会、絶対、出場、絶対、何度も、絶対、したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father went to those industry conferences again and again. He represented us over and over. Always gave his best.
lines.style: Distant, remembering tone. Slower tempo, as if pulling images from years back. Soft on the repeated efforts — admiration mixed with melancholy. Voice trails slightly, caught in the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、総務、絶対、部、絶対、お父さん、絶対、誇りに、絶対、思っていらしたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, our general affairs department was something he took genuine pride in — or so I've heard. That's what his presence meant to all of us.
lines.style: Reverent, almost searching for words. Speaking of something witnessed but not fully known — respectful uncertainty. Gentle tempo. Voice settles on the pride like placing a hand on someone's shoulder.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、プレス、絶対、対応、絶対、自ら、絶対、行ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father handled press relations himself. Took it on directly, personally. Didn't delegate that kind of thing.
lines.style: Nostalgia deepens. Voice carries both admiration and a kind of ache. Measured, unhurried delivery. Slight breathiness on the personal detail — the weight of that commitment. Trailing thought, like there's more unsaid.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、製品の、絶対、出荷、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we've shipped products with care and attention to every detail. That standard he set — we've kept it going. With gratitude for what he taught us.
lines.style: Warm and grounded. Voice softens on the word 'care' — not sentimental, just honest. Steady, reassuring pace. He's speaking a vow as much as a memory. Gentle firmness that says we mean this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、設備の、絶対、故障、絶対、すぐ、絶対、直したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father fixed equipment problems right away. Didn't wait, didn't put it off. That was who he was.
lines.style: Wistful and final. Voice carries quiet admiration. Slower pace, reflective. Each detail is a small tribute. Slight trailing-off, like acknowledging something irretrievable but still present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、契約書の、絶対、名義、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、扱ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we've handled every contract and every document with the care they deserve. That attention — that respect for the work — that came from him. I'm grateful we could continue it.
lines.style: Closing tone, settled wisdom. Voice is calm and clear, but carries the full weight of inheritance. Unhurried. Each word chosen with care. Slight lift at the end — not optimistic, but resolved. Eyes seem to look beyond the present moment.
